definitions.explanation: The ability to understand things deeply and make good judgments.

examples.japanese: {見識|けんしき}が{高|たか}い{人|ひと}。
{見識|けんしき}を{広|ひろ}げる。
{見識|けんしき}のある{意見|いけん}。

notes:
{見識|けんしき} refers to deep understanding and sound judgment gained through experience and study. It implies wisdom rather than mere knowledge.

REGISTER:
This is a formal word often used in written language, business, and academic contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {見識|けんしき}が{高|たか}い/{広|ひろ}い: having great/broad insight
- {見識|けんしき}を{持|も}つ: to have insight
- {見識|けんしき}のある{人|ひと}: a person with discernment
- {見識|けんしき}を{広|ひろ}げる: to broaden one's views

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {知識|ちしき}: knowledge (factual information)
- {洞察|どうさつ}: insight, perception (seeing through)
- {識見|しきけん}: views, opinion (more formal variant)
